title: Large-Booking Percentages in the Host Accounts Fee Schedule
content:
# Host Fee Schedule — Re-Rated Percentage by Booking Size (Host Accounts)

When the host service fee on a stay of a Host Accounts holder is re-rated, the re-rated percentage starts from a figure set by the stay's host-fee base as assessed:

| Host-fee base of the stay, as assessed | Re-rated percentage starts from |
|---|---|
| USD 5000.00 or more | 14.5% |
| At least USD 2500.00 but below USD 5000.00 | 14.75% |
| Below USD 2500.00 | No booking-size band applies |

The host-fee base is the stay's nightly subtotal, cleaning fee, pet fee total and extra-guest fee total as they stood when the fee was assessed.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical stays)

| Host-fee base | Starts from |
|---|---|
| USD 5000.00 | 14.5% |
| USD 4999.99 | 14.75% |
| USD 2500.00 | 14.75% |
| USD 2499.99 | No booking-size band |

The band is read from the host-fee base alone: a stay with a host-fee base of USD 6200.00 starts from 14.5% whatever its length or its number of guests.
